sources.title: Meta's Llama 3.2 goes small with 1B and 3B models.
sources.snippet: The Meta Llama 3.2 collection of multilingual large language models (LLMs) is a collection of pretrained and instruction-tuned generative models in 1B and 3B sizes (text in/text out).
